name: Midas Golden Touch 3
review:
Midas Golden Touch 3 continues the series on a 3x5 grid with 15 lines and a bonus game with free spins and retriggers.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 15,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.16%.

Expect a darker, riskier tone than the earlier games, with the volatility stepped up to High. The core loop is still multiplier wilds and a respin-driven bonus.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
